mappingMethod: explicit geometric-mean scalar projection with recorded axis loss, followed by material-specific Blender 4.4.3 correction factors identified on a collision-supported Cusick fixture; not a universal SI-to-Blender conversion

contactHypothesis.method: shared bounded engineering prior used to isolate density and elastic-property differences in the first Blender calibration render
contactHypothesis.source: not measured; must be replaced by fabric-body and fabric-fabric calibration evidence

propertySemantics.clothSettings.compression_stiffness: in-plane compression and buckling spring proxy derived from projected stretch stiffness
propertySemantics.properties.compressionKpa: through-thickness compression; deliberately unmapped because Blender surface compression stiffness is not the same physical quantity
propertySemantics.clothSettings.collider_friction: dynamic contact hypothesis on the cloth
propertySemantics.collisionObject.collision.cloth_friction: static Coulomb coefficient mapped to Blender's 0-80 percentage scale as 100 * coefficient, verified against Blender 4.4.3 source
propertySemantics.clothCollisionSettings.impulse_clamp: diagnostic object-collision impulse limit; 10 is the smallest Blender 4.4.3 runtime RNA UI step above the disabled value 0

calibrationFixture.purpose: temporal convergence audit at fixed diagnostic material scales before friction or constitutive re-identification; final validation still requires the published approximately 4 mm mesh resolution
calibrationFixture.supportConstraint: no pin group; the planar specimen starts 5 mm above the solid disk and falls freely onto its collision surface

searchPolicy.policy: run one fixed-scale object-collision impulse-clamp diagnostic at 10; do not change damping, quality, collision quality, self collision, contact, mesh, fixture, or elastic factors
searchPolicy.reason: Run 31057250945 rejected global default damping because it suppressed motion and destroyed coefficient plausibility; Blender 4.4.3 runtime RNA explicitly defines impulse_clamp as limiting collision impulses to avoid instability

calibrationScope.transferability: diagnostic factors are solver- and discretization-specific and remain uncalibrated until temporal convergence and direct visual review both pass

basis.description: Clamp collision impulses to avoid instability; 0 disables clamping; hard range 0-100; UI step 10

solverStabilityDiagnostic.decisionRule: retain only if hard upward/contact failures and temporal drift improve without degrading coefficient-fit acceptance or direct visual plausibility
